podcast.title: Influence on Vaporwave
podcast.body: Psych music is identified as one of the source genres from which Vaporwave drew elements, contributing to its unique sound. "Vaporware took bits from Psych, Lounge Music, R&B, and the Chill Wave of the Outs, and then slowed everything down."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: The History of the 2010s Part 3: The New Genres

podcast.title: Tim Buckley's Exploration
podcast.body: Tim Buckley explored the psych genre as part of his musical evolution. "cycling through folk, psych, bits of jazz, fun, and soul."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
